title: Claim-Administration Charge on Northgate Protect Accident Plan Refunds
content:
A claim-administration charge comes off the cancellation refund of a Northgate Protect Accident-tier plan by the claims approved on the plan: the many-approvals charge of $15.00 at 2 approved claims or more, the one-approval charge of $7.50 for exactly one, and nothing for none.

| Claims approved on the plan | Charge off the refund |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | $15.00 |
| Exactly 1 | $7.50 |
| None | Nothing |

- The count is of the administrator's decisions approving a claim on the plan, over the plan's whole history; denied claims are not counted.
- *Hypothetical:* a plan with one approved claim and one denied claim carries $7.50.
